issues.title: As a maintainer, I'd like to create a database using a bulk set of existing documents
issues.body:
There are times when the Game Designer may wish to programmatically generate a set of wargame and message documents, and generate a wargame initialised with that data.

1. in Serge admin, create a new "Populate wargame" button. 
2. When "Populate wargame" is clicked, the user will be invited to browse to a zip-file [*]
3. SERGE will then create a new wargame, and push the zip-folder of documents into it.

The zip-file will contain a collection of JSON documents.   The document id will come from the first part of the JSON document filename.
[Consolidated_Data.zip](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/files/11173557/Consolidated_Data.zip)
